source.name: Juventus FC – Jeep and Visit Detroit to serve as Juventus front-of-shirt partners
source.quote: The combined logos will appear on the First Team Men, Women and Next Gen jerseys in national competitions, while Jeep will be Juventus' primary front-of-shirt sponsor for matches played in international tournaments.

source.name: Visit Detroit – Born Bold: Visit Detroit & Juventus
source.quote: Visit Detroit is proud to be a front-of-shirt partner for the face of Italian football, Juventus FC.

source.name: Juventus FC – WhiteBIT becomes Official Sleeve Partner and Official Cryptocurrency Exchange of Juventus
source.quote: Starting at the FIFA Club World Cup 2025, and continuing through the next three seasons (2025/26, 2026/27 2027/28), the WhiteBIT logo will be visible on the sleeve of the Men's First Team jersey.

source.name: Juventus FC – Juventus and Cygames extend partnership until 2027
source.quote: Cygames' logo will again be worn on the back of the Men's First Team shirt through the 2026/27 campaign,

summary: Jeep and Visit Detroit share the front (domestic games; Jeep alone in Europe), WhiteBIT on the sleeve, Cygames on the back.
